subject: DJ request already in flight: no duplicate; switch addition and established-identity boundary
body:
I now see your live Claude response says the DJ expansion was already briefed as FIVE panels and Grok accepted/started. Treat that as an existing in-flight request. Do not dispatch another four-view batch from my earlier c5a0195a note; its coordinator-proposed four maximum is superseded by this clarification of what is already in flight. Preserve/report the actual existing panels as provisional, not accepted.

Fold Ziggy's ONE addition ea94652a into that same request: co-pilot Chewy flipping ship switches/controls for 'Chewy, drop that beat'. No duplicate Grok send or extra batch.

Important scope correction: Ziggy says use established DJ Chewy references/assets; if missing, report that instead of inventing/recasting him. Your live response calls anatomy a concept study. Absence of accepted Wookiee anatomy does not authorize a new identity. Please verify the chosen mixer-cover appearance (HD-DROP-ca406436d384) and appropriate actual assets before character generation; ask Grok to hold unsupported recasting and report the missing-reference issue, preserving any already generated exploratory files. Stage/style files are only styling/equipment references.

Keep the same photographed SB-W01 weathered Falcon world, cinematic photoreal performance, left/around-bend exploration and roomy integrated DJ equipment. No literal panorama, unrelated spend/settings/benchmark/acceptance/timing approval. Please acknowledge exact awareness and record the one existing send/ack, any amendment/hold, resulting file paths or desktop-app delivery blocker. CFA will not operate your Grok surface.
